system.description: Armor Class: 2 Hit Dice: 7 9 (M) Move: 120' (40') Flying: 180' (60') Attacks: 1 touch or special Damage: 1d10 + double energy drain or special No. Appearing: 1d4 (ld6) Save As: F7-9 Morale: 11 Treasure Type: F Intelligence: 10 Alignment: Chaotic XP Value: 1,250; 1,750 or 2,300 Monster Type: Undead, Enchanted (Rare). Vampires are among the most feared of the undead. They haunt ruins, tombs, crypts and other places deserted by man, but fly out at night to prey on man.
